title: Option trading alone does not build wealth; owning assets does
summary: The speaker says the wheel strategy and option trading in a vacuum do not build real wealth. Wealth comes from owning real or financial assets. He still trades options, but as part of a portfolio built around a core of assets. The clip is short and ends in a waitlist pitch.

steps.caption: How a portfolio responds to market moves for a given mix of assets and options.
The core: owned assets. This part compounds and builds wealth over years.
The options sleeve: a tool on top of the core, not a substitute for it.
Cash: dry powder and the reserve behind cash-secured puts.
The sleeve's worst case. Trading it alone, without the core, leaves only this risk and income.

takeaways: Real wealth comes from owning real or financial assets.
The wheel or options trading on their own are not a wealth plan.
Use options as tools around a core of owned assets.
caveats: The clip is about 30 seconds and ends with a waitlist promotion.
The allocation numbers are illustrative; the speaker gives none.
